long_biography.plain_text:
Grant joined Harris Associates as an analyst in 1988 after studying computer science at the University of Wisconsin–Madison. He later earned an MBA in finance from Loyola University Chicago and became a senior investment analyst. His work followed the firm's value discipline: buying companies at discounts to estimated intrinsic value and favouring owner-oriented management.

As an Oakmark Fund portfolio manager, Grant spent more than two decades directing equity investments. He also served as Harris Associates' co-chief executive and co-chairman, combining research judgment with responsibility for its operating team and leadership development. Grant retired at the end of 2021 after more than thirty-three years with the firm.
